generate-dynamic-erp-mapping-keys:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var prefix = if (payload.targetSystem == "SAP") "Z_" else if (payload.targetSystem == "Oracle") "XX_" else if (payload.targetSystem == "NetSuite") "NS_" else "GEN_"
---
payload.data mapObject (value, key) -> { (prefix ++ key): if (value is String) (value as String)[0 to 19] default value else value }
